fine_trace.note: Attacker-controlled UDP datagram containing an MLE Parent Response message is received on the MLE socket.
The MLE command byte is 10 (kCommandParentResponse), dispatching to HandleParentResponse.
The Response TLV is read from the message into the stack-local ResponseTlv object. The TLV length field is attacker-controlled and can be up to 255.

fine_trace.code: bool IsValid(void) const { return GetLength() >= sizeof(*this) - sizeof(Tlv); }
fine_trace.note: IsValid() only checks GetLength() >= 8 (sizeof(ResponseTlv)-sizeof(Tlv)); it does NOT enforce an upper bound of kMaxSize=8, so a length of 255 passes validation.

fine_trace.code: VerifyOrExit(response.IsValid() && memcmp(response.GetResponse(), mParentRequest.mChallenge, response.GetLength()) == 0, error = OT_ERROR_PARSE);
fine_trace.note: memcmp reads response.GetLength() bytes (up to 255) from response.GetResponse(), which points to the 8-byte mResponse[8] stack buffer, causing a stack-buffer-overflow READ.
